# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series, dying four years later.  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Rachel Lynde's husband  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew was an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure and a stooping posture. He had long, iron-gray hair reaching to his shoulders and wore a full, soft brown beard from the age of twenty. In his later years, he showed stooped shoulders and graying hair, though his appearance changed little over the decades.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c36 P26](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0026)_

## Personality

Matthew was exceptionally shy, quiet, and reclusive, dreading all women except his sister Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde. He hated speaking to strangers or being in large crowds. Despite his extreme bashfulness, he possessed a deeply kind, sympathetic, and generous nature, particularly toward Anne. He preferred expressing himself through silent persistence rather than argument, often quietly getting his way without raising his voice.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c12 P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017)_

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at Green Gables in Avonlea with his sister Marilla. Intending to adopt a young orphan boy to help with farm work as his health declined, he drove to Bright River station only to find eleven-year-old Anne Shirley waiting instead. Touched by her personality and charm during the drive home, he quietly urged Marilla to keep her. Throughout Anne's upbringing, Matthew served as her gentle advocate, spoiling her with gifts such as chocolate sweeties and a dress with puffed sleeves for a school concert. When Anne saved Minnie May Barry from croup, Matthew drove through the night to Bright River to fetch a doctor. He took immense pride in Anne's academic achievements, including her winning of the Avery Scholarship. Shortly after Anne returned home from Queen's Academy, Matthew collapsed and died instantly on the doorstep of Green Gables after reading of the sudden bankruptcy of the Abbey Bank, where all his savings were kept.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c12 P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042), [v1 c18 P22](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0022), [v1 c18 P32](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0032), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P35](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0035), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Son of a shy and silent founder of the Green Gables homestead  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Lived all his life at Green Gables with his sister Marilla  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007)</sub>
- Suffered from heart trouble in his later years  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038)</sub>
